entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The last surviving bloodchief of the Kalastria vampire family on Zendikar and leader of vampire society.

entities.name: Kalastria
entities.description: The wealthiest and most powerful vampire family of Malakir.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Drana's vampires live.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Vampire of the Ghet family who seized holdings outside Malakir and sought to make vampires thralls of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and their brood that devastated Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker whose troops Drana joined on Tazeem.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: General who took command of the forces against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: An angel who fought alongside Drana during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of the multiverse.

events.summary: Kalitas seizes holdings outside Malakir and threatens to make vampires Eldrazi thralls; Drana drives him out and retakes Malakir.
events.quote: She drove Kalitas and his traitors away from the city, retaking control of Malakir.

events.summary: Drana and her people evacuate Malakir before the Eldrazi arrive and she joins Gideon Jura's troops.
events.quote: she decided to join forces with the troops of Gideon Jura on Tazeem

events.summary: Drana begrudgingly lets Tazri take command and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
events.quote: She survived Zendikar's Last Stand with Ulamog and Kozilek

events.summary: Drana and Linvala fight side by side in the skies and grow to respect one another.
events.quote: eventually an appreciation for each other’s unique strengths and combat prowess

relations.quote: Drana is the last surviving bloodchief of the Kalastria
gradually evolved into a grudging respect
